name: Transactor Data 1
definition: Information related to the transactior who provides technical payment solutions for acceptor and originator to conduct transactions.

BusinessIdentification.name: Business Identification
BusinessIdentification.definition: Business or client identification for the  issuer.

LegalCorporateName.name: Legal Corporate Name
LegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the  issuer.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.

LocalData.name: Local Data
LocalData.definition: Contains local language equivalent(s) of data in the current component.

SubMerchant.name: Sub Merchant
SubMerchant.definition: Submerchant is a merchant that uses the transactor to complete the transaction, such as retailer, utility service provider, sponsored merchant. ||Sponsored merchant is a merchant that uses the payment services of another entity, such as marketplace, utility service provider, payment facilitator, third party biller, etc.
